name: Prune
title: Childlike Dreams Cherished
description: A self-proclaimed Witch Hunter from Nod-Krai who traveled to Mondstadt seeking revenge on Alice after believing her imaginary friend Descartes had been kidnapped.

skillTalents.name: Badaboom! Hexbuster Hammer
skillTalents.description: Normal Attack: Performs up to 3 attacks by swinging the Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing Anemo DMG. Charged Attack: Consumes Stamina and performs an upward hammer swing, dealing Anemo DMG to opponents in front. Plunging Attack: Plunges from mid-air and deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact.

skillTalents.name: Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime
skillTalents.description: Prune strikes the Witchlure Bell with her Banehunter Oathhammer, dealing Anemo DMG. If this attack triggers Swirl, the skill changes for a short time to Clang Clang! Witch-tribution Comes!, converting the hammer to the element involved in the Swirl and dealing that Elemental DMG.

skillTalents.name: The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!
skillTalents.description: Prune swings the Witchlure Bell, dealing Anemo DMG to nearby opponents and placing it in Hunter-Seeker mode. In this mode, the bell follows the active character and periodically attacks nearby opponents, dealing AoE Anemo DMG considered Elemental Burst DMG.

passiveTalents.name: Verdict and Punishment
passiveTalents.description: During The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!, if the Hunter-Seeker Witchlure Bell triggers Swirl after dealing DMG, it summons a Banehunter Oathhammer that deals DMG matching the Elemental Conversion from the Swirl.

passiveTalents.name: Tolling Synchronicity
passiveTalents.description: After Prune hits an opponent with a Banehunter Oathhammer that has undergone Elemental Conversion, nearby party members gain Tolling Rally. Their attack talent and elemental talent DMG is increased based on the portion of Prune's ATK above 2,000.

passiveTalents.name: Witchseeker's Vow
passiveTalents.description: After completing Witch's Homework: Of What Is Contested, Prune becomes a Hexerei character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, Hexerei: Secret Rite can increase Prune's ATK and further increase the triggering character's ATK after Swirl reactions.

passiveTalents.name: Tinker-Tink, Clank, and Bang!
passiveTalents.description: Has a chance to obtain 1 extra regional Character Talent Material when crafting, excluding base materials. The extra material matches the rarity of the crafted result.

constellations.name: With a Vow to Rescue, the Journey Begins
constellations.description: After a Banehunter Oathhammer that has undergone Elemental Conversion hits an opponent, Prune restores Energy. This effect has a short cooldown.

constellations.name: Useful for Cleaning Messy Baggage, Elemental Powers Are Indeed
constellations.description: During The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!, Prune gains Hunt the Witch, increasing her ATK and further increasing it when the Witchlure Bell or converted Banehunter Oathhammer hits opponents.

constellations.name: The Caravan Exits the Mountain Pass, the Scenery Once More Changed
constellations.description: Increases the Level of The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On! by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Looking Back Following the Wind, One's Shadow Still Halved
constellations.description: After a converted Banehunter Oathhammer hits an opponent, it ricochets to a nearby opponent, dealing DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type.

constellations.name: 100 Defeats? No Problem, Tomorrow, We Go Again
constellations.description: Increases the Level of Ring-A-Ding-Ding! Hexhunter Chime by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: And That's the Story! Share It With Your Friends!
constellations.description: Extends Hunter-Seeker mode from The Bell Tolls! The Hunt Is On!. After party members affected by Tolling Rally trigger an Elemental Reaction, Prune and other active characters affected by Tolling Rally gain ATK.
